summary: Genius Group Limited filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, announcing the return and cancellation of 20,000,000 Class A Ordinary Shares under an Asset Purchase Agreement with Entrepreneur Resorts Ltd (ERL), equivalent to 16% of the public float. This follows a June 12 repurchase and cancellation of 6,600,000 shares, totaling a 22% reduction in issued capital for the week. The shares were returned by ERL's board and immediately cancelled by Genius Group's board; the balance of identified shares remains reserved for potential claims. The company aims to increase Net Asset Value per Share (NAVPS) for shareholders. No deal-specific prices or premiums are stated, as this is a capital return via share cancellation, not a tender. Watch for further NAVPS accretion and any claims against reserved shares.
